levels.name: Multi-Task no Jutsu
levels.description: The Muji-Muji Daruma created by Yoohoo Art: Mujina Flurry will ignore HP limits and can simultaneously attack nearby opponents and heal characters.

levels.name: Egress Prep
levels.description: Yoohoo Art: Fuuin Dash gains the following effects: DMG of Fuufuu Whirlwind Kick in Tapping (mobile)/Press (PC & PlayStation) Mode increased by 3.3%. Every 0.5s in the Fuufuu Windwheel state will increase the DMG of this Fuufuu Whirlwind Kick by 3.3%. The maximum DMG increase possible through this method is 66%.

levels.name: Eh, the Bunshin Can Handle It
levels.description: Increases the Level of Yoohoo Art: Mujina Flurry by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

levels.name: Skiving: New and Improved
levels.description: Sayu recovers 1.2 Energy when she triggers a Swirl reaction. This effect occurs once every 2s.

levels.name: Speed Comes First
levels.description: Increases the Level of Yoohoo Art: Fuuin Dash by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

levels.name: Sleep O'Clock
levels.description: The Muji-Muji Daruma created by Sayu's Yoohoo Art: Mujina Flurry will now also benefit from her Elemental Mastery. Each point of Sayu's Elemental Mastery will produce the following effects: Increases the damage dealt by the Muji-Muji Daruma's attacks by 0.2% ATK. A maximum DMG increase of 400% ATK can be gained via this method. Increases the HP restored by the Muji-Muji Daruma by 3. A maximum of 6,000 additional HP can be restored in this manner.
